transcript.speaker: Bram
transcript.text: "The *Merrow* went down on the reef nine winters back. Twelve hands. I pulled two of them out myself."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Only two?"

transcript.speaker: Bram
transcript.text: He nods slowly. "The rest the sea kept."

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The storm breaks just after midnight. A shutter tears loose on the east side and the lamp gutters.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I wedge the shutter with a chair and trim the wick until the flame steadies.

transcript.speaker: Odile
transcript.text: "You kept it lit," she says from the doorway. "Good."
